expires_today.title: Freedom to Create with COREL Graphics Suite 2025
expires_today.long_description:
Feel like your graphic design projects could use a little more pizzazz? Take your art to the next level with the 2025 edition of CorelDRAW Graphics Suite—professional quality graphic design software with all the bells and whistles. For a massive discount you’ll get everything this CorelDRAW suite has to offer, from vector illustration software, image processing, font and layout managers, and more! Whether you’re creating your own art pieces or designing for a brand, these programs will help you bring your ideas to life and give them energy and style. You won’t find a deal this good for software this essential anywhere else, so grab it now at the price of your choosing, and support Extra Life charity through Children’s Miracle Network Hospitals with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before July 31st, 2027. Permanent Perpetual License

expires_today.title: Pathfinder Second Edition Bundle of Frogs! By Paizo Inc.
expires_today.long_description:
If your tabletop game nights are croaking, you could use a frog-themed boost from this bundle of Pathfinder Second Edition TTRPG adventures and miniature printable sets from Paizo! This bundle includes the ribbiting–erm, riveting Dawn of the Frogs, a mystery set in the swampy mires of Bog Bottom, both in PDF form and as a physical boxed set (miniature printables included)! If frogs aren’t your speed, try out the Extinction Curse storyline, beginning with the circus-set murder mystery The Show Must Go On! Or take to the skies in a flying airship and search the wilderness for magical beasts in Howl of the Wild! There are whole worlds to explore in this giant Pathfinder bundle, so get a crew together, grab it while it’s hot at the price of your choosing, and support the Craft Emergency Relief Fund with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before December 31st 2026.

expires_tomorrow.title: Cosmos Eclipse Game Dev Assets & Tools bundle (Unreal + Unity + Godot)
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Unleash your creative potential and bring your imagination to life like never before with a curated selection of premium 3D assets for Unity and Unreal Engine! Design your own take on the Big Apple with the 1950s NYC Megapack, quarter your forces within realistic fortifications with the Military Base Megapack, or add lived-in grit and character to your old-time titles with the Medieval Village Megapack. The savings don’t stop there—grab this massive 70+ pack bundle and unlock a 1-month subscription to Leartes’ Cosmos collection! Plus, a portion of your purchase helps support our furry friends at Canine Companions!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before July 1st, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Picos, HATs, and More by Raspberry Pi Press
expires_tomorrow.description: Make your projects come to life
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Turn your tech dreams into reality with this bundle of comprehensive and practical resources from Raspberry Pi! Get a crash course in making anything and everything with the 2026 edition of The Official Raspberry Pi Handbook, and go deeper with manuals on AI projects, the Sense HAT, MicroPython, GPIO Zero, and more! Whether you’re building computers, experimenting with designing programs, making a game, or just want to try out some simple exercises to get comfortable with a new hobby, this bundle will give you the power to take technology into your own hands. Grab these Raspberry Pi ebooks now for the price of your choice, and support the Raspberry Pi Foundation’s efforts to get kids into coding with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Squad Goals
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Grab a friend or two and cozy up with the Squad Goals Bundle, an epic collection of co-op titles perfect for staying connected with your bestie this summer. Use your Turtle Power to rescue Master Splinter from the evil Foot Clan in Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate, a rad roguelike with endless replayability that comes packed with the Metalhead DLC! Or race against the clock to get dishes out hot in PlateUp!, a fast-paced restaurant management sim! Pay what you want for eight amazing co-op games and help support Child's Play when you shop with Humble!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before January 31st, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Narrative 12 for $10 Bundle
expires_tomorrow.description: Be a part of the story
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Fighting boss battles and journeying through open worlds is fun and all, but sometimes all a great game needs is a great story worth immersing ourselves in for a few hours. Get 12 games for $10 in this bundle full of tales of all genres, from hard boiled detective yarns with a retro spin to atmospheric mysteries about missing families. Search for clues through your empty childhood house in Gone Home. Tend your homestead and try not to think about the increasingly disturbing letters you get in the mail in The Stillness of the Wind. Join an occult detective in the kinda-haunted city of Twin Lakes in The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark. There are even more great stories to experience in this bundle, so grab these games now for just $10, and support mental health charity Take This with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before July 31st, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: VFX Master-Bundle For Unreal
expires_tomorrow.description: Discover the very best in VFX
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Crank up the volume on your next game or video with the VFX Master-Bundle for Unreal Engine. This gigantic library of high-quality assets from VRhinoFX gives you the dynamic VFX effects you need to add Hollywood-quality polish to your creative projects. Cast a charm on your players with the powerful RPG - Magic VFX collection, which features Holy Light, Blood, Fire, Poison, Darkness, and Lightning—pay what you want for realistic magical explosions and help support Make-A-Wish, too!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before June 5th, 2027.
